# Refleo

> Refleo gives therapists a pre-session brief built from their clients' voice and text check-ins between appointments. HIPAA covered, parental consent built in, free for two months.

Refleo is made by Refleo Health, Inc., founded in 2026 by Vishwas Vijayan and Rishi Anarkat. Clinicians use it on the web at https://app.refleohealth.com and on iPhone; their clients use the free Refleo iPhone app or https://my.refleohealth.com. Clients never pay. Clinicians get two months free, then $100 a month.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://www.refleohealth.com/product/): how between-session check-ins become a pre-session brief for the clinician.
- [Pricing](https://www.refleohealth.com/pricing/): free for two months, then $100 a month per clinician; free for clients.
- [Refleo for clinicians (web app)](https://app.refleohealth.com/): sign in or start a free trial.
- [Refleo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/refleo/id6807892935): the iPhone app for clinicians and clients.

## Company

- [About](https://www.refleohealth.com/about/): the founders and why Refleo exists.
- [Contact](https://www.refleohealth.com/contact/): support@refleohealth.com.

## Legal and privacy

- [Terms of Service](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/terms/2026-09-18/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/privacy/2026-09-18/)
- [Business Associate Agreement](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/baa/1.0/): signed by every clinician; Refleo is a HIPAA business associate.
- [Parental Consent and Authorization](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/parental_consent/1.0/): required before a client under 18 can use Refleo.
- [Minor Acknowledgment](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/minor_acknowledgment/1.0/)
- [Subprocessors](https://www.refleohealth.com/legal/subprocessors/): the vendors that process data on Refleo's behalf.
